quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 08-14-2026, consolidated K-IFRS): H1 revenue KRW 81,978M, +23.0% YoY (H1 2025: KRW 66,667M); Q2 revenue KRW 45,946M, +35.0% YoY (Q2 2025: KRW 34,027M) and +27.5% QoQ (Q1 2026: KRW 36,033M). Operating loss narrowed to -KRW 1,531M for H1 (H1 2025: -KRW 2,571M; Q2 2026: -KRW 1,174M vs -KRW 1,020M); gross profit KRW 13,638M (16.6% margin). Net loss -KRW 6,183M (Q2 -KRW 6,541M, EPS -522) because Q2 booked a KRW 7,599M derivative valuation loss on the call option embedded in the April 2026 convertible bond plus KRW 1,998M interest. Parent-only (separate) H1: revenue KRW 65,058M (+36.6% YoY), operating PROFIT +KRW 2,151M (H1 2025: +KRW 236M). Mix H1 2026: design SERVICES 89.89% (KRW 73,685M) of which HPC 36.22% (KRW 29,688M, already above the KRW 21,193M booked in all of FY2025), AI 21.08% (KRW 17,278M), automotive 7.31% (KRW 5,995M), big data 4.30%, mobile 3.11%, other 17.87%; mass-production PRODUCTS 7.75% (KRW 6,357M); other 2.36%. Exports of design services jumped to KRW 40,203M (49% of H1 revenue) versus KRW 18,978M for the whole of FY2025 - overseas HPC/AI design wins now outweigh domestic work (KRW 33,482M). Employees 877 consolidated (726 R&D/technical), 443 at the parent (365 R&D).

Contract assets (unbilled design work) KRW 40,444M; contract liabilities KRW 6,714M. Fifteen in-progress custom-IC development contracts each worth 5%+ of FY2025 revenue are listed (contracts A-O, signed 2023-07-13 to 2026-06-04, completion dates out to 2028-03-31); three were signed in H1 2026 (2026-03-16, 2026-05-11, 2026-06-04). ASIC design contract, signed 2023-08-31, amended 2025-12-08, term to 2026-11-30, amount undisclosed (USD + KRW). quarterly_data.signal: Supply side / capex (half-year report, separate-entity purchase table, H1 2026): AD Technology is fabless - wafers are produced at external fabs (Samsung Foundry DSP since 2020-11; Samsung Foundry best-engineering DSP award 2022-05), so its inputs are IP licences and outsourced processing. Total purchases KRW 44,279M in H1 versus KRW 65,109M for all of FY2025: IP KRW 27,089M (imported IP KRW 25,674M / USD 17,303K, already 60% of FY2025's KRW 42,898M - front-loading for new 2nm/4nm HPC design starts), wafers KRW 1,184M (USD 798K; average 12-inch wafer price USD 2,783 vs USD 2,710 in FY2025, 8-inch USD 1,251), outsourced FAB processing KRW 12,260M (domestic KRW 12,043M, roughly equal to the whole of FY2025's KRW 12,211M), packaging KRW 406M, test KRW 638M, other outsourcing KRW 2,701M. Consolidated outsourced-processing expense rose to KRW 20,047M from KRW 12,348M a year earlier. Filing notes 3-8% price cuts are negotiated with major SCM suppliers case by case. Capex: PP&E additions KRW 11,277M in H1 (machinery KRW 8,893M - machinery gross book value jumped from KRW 14,556M to KRW 23,449M), construction-in-progress KRW 29,822M, plus a KRW 26,494M commitment with Gyeonggi Housing & Urban Development Corporation (GH) for a 3rd Pangyo Techno Valley site; a KRW 21,500M Korea Development Bank facility loan (maturity 2040-06-27) and a KRW 50B undrawn KDB facility line back the build. Intangible additions KRW 15,333M (capitalised development costs KRW 14,653M). Inventory only KRW 2,018M (0.48% of assets).

quarterly_data.signal: Catalysts / pipeline (half-year report): (1) Financing - 4th-series KRW 130,000M zero-coupon private convertible bond issued 2026-04-29 (board resolution 2026-04-21; arranged by Korea Investment & Securities and NH Investment & Securities), conversion price KRW 54,603 = 2,380,821 shares (17.7% of the 13,462,007 shares outstanding), conversion window 2027-04-29 to 2031-03-29, maturity 2031-04-29, investor put from 2028-10-29, issuer call 2027-04-29 to 2028-10-29; KRW 20,768M used for working capital by 2026-06-30, KRW 109,232M parked in deposits/MMT/wrap. Cash KRW 70,529M plus short-term instruments KRW 60,808M; debt ratio 133.3%. (2) R&D - H1 R&D spend KRW 20,875M (32.09% of separate revenue) versus KRW 10,807M for all of FY2025, with KRW 14,559M capitalised as development costs; consolidated R&D outlay KRW 22,438M. Named programmes: Samsung 2nm Arm Neoverse V3 ADP620 HPC platform with DDR5 RDIMM, 16-lane PCIe Gen6, CXL 3.0, UCIe chiplet-to-chiplet interface and BMC/UEFI secure boot, running 2024-11 to 2028-07 with silicon bring-up targeted at first-pass success; Arm Neoverse N2 ADP-600 HPC platform (CMN mesh, USB/PCIe/Ethernet/DDR, 2025-01 to 2026-12); 2nm and 4nm Foundation-IP (standard-cell library + SRAM compiler) and HPC design kits as a Samsung Foundry Foundation-IP service partner (to 2026-12); 2.5D chiplet design methodology combining HBM3e PHY/controller and a 2nm big die in one package with 14.4Tbps-class 112G PAM4 SerDes, silicon-interposer stitch-line avoidance and integrated silicon capacitors for PDN (2023-03 to 2026-12). (3) Corporate - Arm Total Design partner since 2023-10, Synopsys IP OEM partnership since 2023-07; charter amended 2026-03-30 to raise CB/BW issuance flexibility and adopt electronic AGMs; RSUs (224,700 shares) granted 2026-02-24; credit rating BB+ reaffirmed by NICE D&B on 2026-05-14; seven patents filed since 2025-09 (radiation-hardened flip-flop, dynamic-latch standard cells, multi-bit flip-flop, library verification). Share price: June 2026 average KRW 34,752, 2026-06-30 close KRW 28,300 (April 2026 peak KRW 60,500).
